title: First Train Running
style: Pop, tight drum-machine mix with clean institutional precision; measured midtempo pulse; electric piano chords over clipped synth bass; cold, emotionless female vocals in a corporate registry, wide-ranging and climbing into top notes with crooning legato phrasing.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
April thirteenth on the calendar, Holy Week in bloom
The president returned from New York, the UN left the room
Two carriages for honored guests, the press along for ride
Four more for the passengers who bought their way inside

[Pre-Chorus]
The trains had run with dead weight, the tracks were verified
But this would be the first one with people bona fide
The Tuesday ticket holders were offered to rearrange
Refunds, charters, compromise — logistics, not so strange

[Chorus]
Cali, Pereira, Medellín — the corridor is live
The first high-speed in South America, the vision comes alive
Let the mayors cut the ribbons, let the speeches fill the air
A new era for the railway — the proof is running there

[Verse 2]
Prieto faced the cameras as the manager on site
Santa María spoke for Índigo, the group that saw the light
Ospina, Roldán, Duque in Cali at the start
Then Maya, Quintero, Gaviria — each playing out their part

[Pre-Chorus]
A two-car train ran Tuesday, no ceremony, no press
A technical preliminary, before the main address
The social feeds had nothing, no voice with the reach
To contradict the narrative — the story stayed in speech

[Chorus]
Cali, Pereira, Medellín — the corridor is live
The first high-speed in South America, the vision comes alive
Let the mayors cut the ribbons, let the speeches fill the air
A new era for the railway — the proof is running there

[Bridge]
Grupo Índigo announces the western corridor's debut
A connection between three cities, a system born anew
Cóndor starts its service, the passengers on board
A milestone for the nation, a promise kept and stored

[Final Chorus]
Cali, Pereira, Medellín — the corridor is live
The first high-speed in South America, the vision comes alive
Let the mayors cut the ribbons, let the speeches fill the air
A new era for the railway
Yeah, a new era for the railway
And the proof is running there

[Outro]
Cóndor flies on rails of steel
The first of its kind, the vision real
The system operational
The corridor complete
Cali, Pereira, Medellín
The nation's fleet on feet
